title: Viewing hours and stream limits
description: Serves "They see only what they may."; "What can't be done is said plainly.". The owner: parental viewing hours and simultaneous-stream limits (D-144).
acceptanceCriteria: The operator sets, for an account or a profile, the hours it may watch, and for an account how many streams it may play at once.
A play outside the hours, or beyond the limit, is refused with a reason that says which, and when it can play.
When the hours end mid-film, the next request for the film is refused with that reason, and the app is told (JS-197).
A stream ends and frees its place at once when its app says it stopped, and otherwise 90 seconds after its last report. A paused playback whose app still holds it counts.
Every capability it adds is in the published contract (JS-183) and passes its conformance check.
A play refused for the limit lists the account's devices holding playbacks, naming a title only for the viewer's own profile; the viewer can end one from the app, and their play then starts.
